preset.label: VibeVoice 1.5B TTS
preset.source: authored from /object_info (VibeVoiceTTS + SaveAudio); model pinned to the installed VibeVoice-1.5B
preset.description: Long-form / multi-speaker speech. Mark speakers with [1], [2]; plain text is read by speaker 1. VibeVoice 1.5B clones the voice of a short speech sample: pick one, or leave it empty to use verify-voice.flac from ComfyUI input (a Chatterbox test voice).

model.label: Voice model
model.info: Which VibeVoice model to use. 1.5B is faster; 7B can sound better but needs much more memory (use 4-bit with it).

quant4.label: 4-bit
quant4.info: Loads the 7B model's language part in 4-bit so it fits in less graphics memory, at a small cost in quality. Only used with the 7B model.

steps.label: Steps
steps.info: How many refinement passes for the sound. 10 is the default; more is slower and rarely needed.

cfg.label: Voice adherence (cfg)
cfg.info: How closely the speech sticks to the voice sample. 1.3 is the default; higher can sound strained.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.info: How much variation goes into the speech. Lower is steadier; higher is livelier but less predictable.

vram.basis: weights: 5.2 GB bf16 (Qwen2.5-1.5B LLM + diffusion head + tokenizers)

inputs.label: Voice sample (a few seconds of speech to clone)

info.prompt: The text to speak. Mark speakers with [1], [2] at the start of their lines for a conversation; plain text is read by speaker 1.
info.audio: A few seconds of clean speech whose voice is copied. Leave empty to use verify-voice.flac from ComfyUI's input folder.

inputs.text: [1] Hello. This is a short test.
